cr_data.provenance: Coe Kerr Gallery, New York, NY and Larry Shar, New York, NY, 1979; (Judy Goffman, New York, NY); (Peacock Galleries, Scottsdale, Arizona); Gerald Peters Gallery, Santa Fe, New Mexico, 1981; Private collection, Santa Fe, New Mexico, 1982; (Newspace, Los Angeles, California) (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive. Painting was verso of cat. no. 464, which did not exist as a separate painting until 1979, when the two were separated by Julius Lowy, New York, NY. Dated 1923 on basis of image. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
